description: Tüfekci and Kaya publish 9,568 hourly averaged observations of a combined-cycle power plant operating at full load. Coverage spans 2006 to 2011 at one unnamed plant; the inspected metadata do not establish its country. The predictors are ambient temperature, ambient pressure, relative humidity and steam-turbine exhaust vacuum, paired with net electrical output reported in MW. Although the page sometimes calls the target energy, its stated unit is power, not MWh. UCI supplies XLSX and ODS workbooks free under CC BY 4.0 for regression benchmarks. A limitation is that the released data are shuffled five times for two-fold evaluations, and the full-load sample cannot directly characterise startup or part-load operation. Simulation uses include fitting weather-dependent full-load performance surrogates for generation studies. It complements data-us-ccgt-operational-benchmark, which describes annual fleet performance, not these hourly plant observations. No workbook was downloaded, and chronological continuity was not verified.
